services.name: MusicBrainz
services.implementation: Identifying User-Agent with https://github.com/A-Igumenov/WheelDesk contact, globally spaced requests >= 1.1 seconds, bounded requests and cached results; no supplementary ratings/tags/reviews used.

services.name: Wikidata
services.implementation: Uses only album entity links and P18 image statements; no arbitrary image searches.

services.name: Wikimedia Commons
services.data: per-file libre image licence, checked before display
services.implementation: Imageinfo extmetadata allowlist: CC0, public domain with Copyrighted=False, CC BY and CC BY-SA 2.0/2.5/3.0/4.0. NC/ND, unknown rights, additional restrictions and missing attribution are rejected. Source, creator, credit and licence URI are retained; full attribution is accessible on Now Playing and Legal. Only upload.wikimedia.org image URLs are accepted.
